title: aegilops triuncialis subvar. subglabra
intro: Aegilops triuncialis subvar. subglabra, commonly known as smooth brome, is a plant species within the wheat grass family, native to Europe and Asia. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is rich in antioxidants, which provide health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Aegilops triuncialis subvar. subglabra include its potential to reduce stress, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents found in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
